title: Crestline Credit Card Account Status: Suspension, Reinstatement and Closure
content:
Crestline Credit Card account status follows the payment record.

## Status changes made by the system

| Days past due (from the earliest unpaid due date) | Status effect |
|---|---|
| exceeds the product's suspension figure | charging privileges are suspended |
| every past-due minimum paid | charging privileges are restored |
| reaches the product's charge-off figure on a suspended account | the bank closes the account |

## Closure at the cardholder's request

Closing an account is the cardholder's own decision: the agent registers the closure request and the cardholder confirms it. **The account must be in status active when the cardholder's closure is completed**, as the account record shows it. A suspended account cannot be closed at the cardholder's request until it is reinstated.

## After closure

No purchase posts. The remaining balance, including any promotional plan, is repaid under the product's closed-account terms, and statements, interest, accruals, late fees and merchandise credits continue until the balance is zero.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An active account with a 900 USD balance on a 12-month deferred plan is closed at the cardholder's request: the plan keeps running and statements continue until the balance is zero.
- A suspended account asks to close: the closure cannot be completed until the past-due minimums are paid and the account is reinstated to active.
